title: Efficiency under a Markov Illness-Death Model for Time-Varying Survivor Average Causal Effects
banked_reason: Normalized D0.5 review grades the delivered note incremental below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 6.2 < 7.4); simultaneous process inference and bands remain open.
gap_reasons: It does not prove uniformly honest simultaneous bands, multiplier validity, covariance consistency, the sharp smoothness frontier, or efficiency in the inequality-constrained model at binding laws.
The missing feasible inference theory, full-surface bands, boundary result, and pancreatic-cancer application keep the package below the stronger leading-journal benchmarks.

proof_attempt_summary: The D0 graph proved baseline-aware identification, the Markov covariance-gap result, an occupation-weighted surface rate, and fixed-collection Gaussian limits above beta>d+1. D0.5 found a below-field delivered package; bounded repairs corrected initial-state, projection-sign, and iid-CLT defects before banking. Simultaneous bands, feasible covariance estimation, the sharp smoothness frontier, and constrained-boundary efficiency remain open.
tldr: Death truncates readmission, so the clinically relevant target is a two-index survivor contrast. For a post-baseline cohort whose potential illness--death paths start event-free at time zero, the smooth Markov observed-data envelope yields an explicit canonical-gradient covariance surface and a Loewner positive-semidefinite covariance reduction relative to unrestricted-history coarsening; the proved strict-gain statement is diagonal and does not imply elementwise off-diagonal covariance shrinkage. The cross-fitted estimator is uniformly consistent at \(n^{-1/2}+r_n^{3/2}\) without any positive lower bound on state-1 occupation. At each fixed relative-interior law and when \(\beta>d+1\), every prespecified finite collection of TV-SACE and RM-SACE coordinates has a joint root-\(n\) influence-function expansion and Gaussian limit. Simultaneous bands over the full triangular index remain open because measurable conditional equicontinuity, covariance consistency, multiplier validity, studentization, and any sharper second-order frontier have not been proved.
gap: Comment et al. define the clinically useful surface but do not give a frequentist Markov-envelope covariance bound or joint process theory. Existing multistate influence-function papers work in larger history models and on marginal occupation targets, while existing survival bands have one time index; none resolves the additional rare-state projected drift under ordinary smoothness.
fill: The project pairs an explicit tangent-space projection and covariance-gap identity with occupation-weighted transition learning, separate propensity and censoring learning, null-risk-set score conventions, an attainable \(n^{-1/2}+r_n^{3/2}\) surface rate, and a formal sensitivity path for the new continuum principal-ignorability restriction. Higher-order correction and measurable two-index multiplier control are isolated as the residual route to root-\(n\) simultaneous bands.
